propositions: A `recheck-review` comment must enable contributors to manually re-trigger LLM reviews on coverage-gap infrastructure vetoes without requiring a new patchset push.

The trigger must refuse re-review of real finding-BLOCK verdicts (including merge-change forms) to prevent stochastic re-rolling of genuine defects; all other non-finding states (coverage-gaps, pass, vote-less, unparseable) are eligible.
Retrigger acceptance must reset the per-revision retry budget from ticket 0347 and enqueue via the existing forced review path to harmonize escalation semantics.

The Gerrit webhook.config must subscribe to comment-added events and route them to a separate retrigger handler that fetches the bot's current-revision message tag to decide eligibility from privileged durable state, never contributor input.
Reply comments must use message-only Gerrit REST bodies with no labels key to avoid side-effect label writes.
Bot self-comments and non-matching tokens must be silent no-ops; operator /rerun endpoint must also reset attempts budget before enqueueing.
